sections.title: Professional Summary
bullets: Digital transformation and project professional combining hands-on product development with 4+ years of complex project and operations coordination in multinational environments.

Founder and developer of apollo::rio, an independent digital platform for Rio de Janeiro’s culture and creative ecosystem, responsible for product roadmap, UX/UI, web development, automation, integrations, governance and continuous improvement.

Strong background in stakeholder engagement, process mapping, reporting, training and adoption: from ISO 9001 process formalisation at C-Tank to technical instruction for multinational offshore teams and project coordination at Van Oord.
Advanced English, MBA in Project Management, Advanced Excel and Power BI, with active hands-on development in JavaScript, Python, JSON, APIs, workflow automation and AI-assisted digital solutions.

lead.title: Founder & Digital Product Developer — apollo::rio (Nov 2024–Present)
lead.body: Designed and developed an independent digital platform for Rio de Janeiro’s cultural and creative ecosystem. Own the product roadmap and delivery across UX/UI, web architecture, WordPress-based services, APIs, structured data, automation, user flows, access roles, documentation and continuous improvement. Built integrations and workflows for event discovery, user services, community features and operational automation, applying privacy-by-design, accessibility, mobile-first principles and AI-assisted development.

entries.role: Marine Operations Superintendent (Projects, Performance & Stakeholder Coordination)
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder project execution across vessels, clients, terminals, suppliers, contractors and international management, coordinating priorities, dependencies, risks and operational deliverables.
Produced management reports, forecasts, KPI tracking and performance analyses covering production, availability, downtime, fuel, costs and operational deviations.
Standardised reporting, procedures, action tracking and information flows across projects, improving visibility, traceability and decision-making between field and management teams.
Supported change implementation through procedures, briefings, alignment meetings, lessons learned, corrective actions and continuous-improvement initiatives in multicultural environments.
Coordinated vendors and service providers and translated operational requirements into practical execution plans, maintaining clear communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

entries.role: Operations Analyst (Process Improvement, Digital Workflows & Offshore Support)
bullets: Mapped and formalised internal processes, created procedures and document-control practices, and supported the company’s preparation for ISO 9001 implementation with external audit/consulting support.

Conceived the functional architecture of an internal operational-integration solution connecting Warehouse, HR, Finance, invoicing and operational documentation, simplifying access to critical information and workflows.
Managed operational information and compliance workflows in Petrobras Drake / SAP RT, including documentation, qualification matrices, personnel readiness and logistics data.
Produced DPR/RDO reports, monitored execution, indicators, deliverables and deviations, and coordinated crews, materials, suppliers and offshore-service readiness for FPSO/OSV campaigns.
Supported digital records, logistics workflows, documentation control and operational mobilisation for offshore clients, including qualification and credentialing data in Petrobras systems.
Delivered technical training to multinational offshore teams, translating SOPs and creating practical learning support for operational, safety and emergency communication.
Helped users adopt technical terminology and procedures through direct instruction, coaching and contextual learning in high-risk, multicultural environments.
International engineering research involving structured data collection, technical analysis, testing support and multidisciplinary collaboration.
